content.text: 01.11.26 Marathon 4, 5, 6 or 7 Nights Guaranteed Entry The New York Marathon presented by New York Road Runners Run through all five boroughs of New York City in the TCS New York City Marathon. Experience the world’s largest marathon as you pass iconic landmarks and vibrant neighbourhoods, taking in an atmosphere unlike any other major marathon race worldwide. Secure your entry in the 2026 TCS New York City Marathon – an Abbott World Marathon Majors event and enjoy full support from our expert team. From pre-race briefings and shakeout runs to dedicated reps in every hotel and a memorable post-race celebration in Times Square at the Hard Rock Café, our packages ensure a seamless NYC metro area marathon experience from start to finish. The New York marathon is known as one of the most popular marathons in the world and welcomes 50,000 runners from across the world to take part in this iconic running event. Please note we are not permitted to sell packages to US residents. ENTRY & EXTRAS Marathon Entry £525 per person NEW YORK MARATHON ROUTE The TCS New York Marathon takes you from Staten Island through the five boroughs of New York: Staten Island, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, and to Manhattan’s iconic finish in Central Park. The experience of running the TCS New York City Marathon will stay with you for life. TRAVEL INFORMATION Getting to New York If you’re traveling to the TCS New York City Marathon, you’ll likely arrive through one of the city’s three major airports: John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK), Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR), or LaGuardia Airport (LGA). Most international flights land at JFK or Newark, while LaGuardia serves mainly domestic routes and is the closest airport to Manhattan. From JFK: Take the AirTrain to connect with the subway for around a 60-minute ride into Midtown. A yellow cab from JFK to Manhattan has a flat fare of $70 plus tolls and tip, usually taking 45–75 minutes depending on traffic. From Newark: The AirTrain links to New Jersey Transit trains, reaching Penn Station in about 45 minutes. Taxi or rideshare fares range from $70–$90. From LaGuardia: Expect a 30–60 minute taxi ride to Manhattan, costing around $40–$60 plus tolls and tip. Getting around New York New York’s public transportation is the most convenient way to explore the city during marathon week. Subway: Runs 24/7, with 472 stations connecting all five boroughs – making it the fastest and most affordable option for marathon runners and spectators. A single ride costs $2.90, or you can purchase a MetroCard or OMNY tap-to-pay for easy access. Buses: Cover routes not served by the subway and also accept MetroCard and OMNY. Taxis: For direct trips, yellow taxis and green Boro Taxis are licensed and regulated, while Uber and Lyft are widely available. Walking is another great way to soak up the atmosphere and experience the city’s vibrant neighbourhoods before and after race day. WHY BOOK WITH US? With Sports Tours, you never run alone. We’ll meet you at your hotel, escort you to the race expo and get you to the start line with ease. Join us for a 5KM shakeout run, meet fellow runners and celebrate together post-race. INCLUDED IN YOUR PACKAGE: ADDITIONAL INFORMATION 4–7 nights’ accommodation at 4* & 5* hotels near Times Square Full support from Sports Tours reps throughout your trip Detailed pre-race briefing Welcome drinks at Margaritaville Guided 5KM shakeout run Saturday afternoon – The SUMMIT Experience Guided start-line transfer (ferry or bus) Marathon after-party ticket – Hard Rock Café, Times Square Itinerary DAY 1 – ARRIVAL DAY Welcome to New York City! Check-in to your hotel today and familiarise yourself with the Big Apple! A Sports Tours International rep will be at the hotel to greet you and answer any questions you may have. Bag Drop: Clients must complete bag drop in Central Park on Friday or Saturday. Bags will be securely stored and ready for pick-up after the finish. (Please note runners will receive a full itinerary in the lead up to the event) DAY 2 – PRE-RACE BRIEFING & WELCOME DRINKS The Sports Tours team will host a pre-race briefing in the morning alongside expert coaches from event organisers, New York Road Runners. Find out exactly what’s in store on race day and ask any questions as we attempt to help those pre-race nerves. Kick off your New York Marathon weekend with our welcome drinks at Margaritaville, the perfect chance to relax after your journey and settle into the city. It’s an ideal opportunity to meet others in your group, share the excitement ahead, and enjoy a fun, informal atmosphere before the big race weekend begins. DAY 3 – SHAKEOUT RUN & SUMMIT Experience In the morning, join us for a gentle 5km group shakeout run from your hotel led by our team of reps, everyone welcome! Alternatively, you are welcome to take part in the official New York Road Runners 5km Dash. Starting on 47th Street and 1st Avenue, run through midtown Manhattan and cross the finish line in Central Park. You will be able to book this at a later date. On Saturday afternoon, enjoy the SUMMIT One Vanderbilt Experience, featuring breath-taking 360° views of New York City, immersive art installations, and soaring observation decks. We will also be escorting our runners to the Marathon Expo today to browse merchandise and explore the exhibits. DAY 4 – NEW YORK CITY MARATHON 2026 Today’s the day! Transport to the start of the race has been organised by New York Road Runners and bus transfers are included within your race entry fee (ballot runners will need to purchase tickets from NYRR). Your Sports Tours rep will escort you to the bus departure point. Buses leave from various locations from between 4 & 6am. Once you arrive at the start area on Staten Island, you will then head through security and into your corrals (your running bib will show this detail). Celebrate your incredible New York Marathon experience at our official post-race After Party in the heart of Times Square. This is your chance to unwind and soak up the atmosphere with fellow runners and supporters after an unforgettable day. Enjoy a lively evening at the iconic Hard Rock Café, with great food, a selection of drinks, and a live band providing the soundtrack as we celebrate your marathon success. It’s the perfect setting to relax, relive race-day stories, and dance the night away in true New York style! DAY 5 – DEPARTURE DAY! Take time to rest your legs and enjoy everything New York has to offer, if time permits, before your onward journey. Accommodation Sports Tours International have multiple stay durations at 4* and 5* accommodation in Midtown Manhattan, specifically chosen to simplify the logistics, so you can enjoy comfort during your New York Marathon trip. Whether you want to be steps away from the bright lights of Broadway or nestled on the edge of Central Park for an easier stroll back from the finish line, our hotels provide the high comfort retreat you need to conquer the five boroughs. For the ultimate experience, opt for our 5-star Mandarin Oriental, offering luxury amenities, a central location, and exceptional service for an unforgettable marathon weekend. FAQs The NEW YORK CITY Marathon 2026 date What date is the New York City Marathon 2026? The 2026 TCS New York City Marathon takes place on the first Sunday in November, as it does every year. This iconic marathon race is held in the NYC metro area and is part of the Abbott World Marathon Majors, attracting tens of thousands of runners from around the world. Registering for the NEW YORK CITY Marathon How can I register for the New York City Marathon? The simplest way to secure entry is through our Sports Tours International packages, which include guaranteed race entry. Independent runners can enter via the public lottery, which is highly competitive. Booking with us removes the uncertainty of the lottery, and we handle your race bib, entry fee, and all registration details, ensuring a stress-free experience. The NEW YORK CITY Marathon qualifying times What are the New York City Marathon Qualifying Times? There are no qualifying times required when booking through Sports Tours International. While elite runners compete for world-class times, recreational participants entering independently must rely on the lottery or charity entry routes. The marathon’s prestige, history, and status as part of the Abbott World Marathon Majors make it one of the most sought-after races in the world. Travel and accommodation options What travel and accommodation options are available? Sports Tours International offers carefully selected hotel packages in New York City, chosen for their convenient locations near the NYC metro area marathon course. We strongly recommend travel insurance, which can be arranged as an add-on to give peace of mind when traveling internationally. Official organisations involved of the NEW YORK CITY Marathon Who are the official organisations involved at the New York Marathon? The New York City Marathon is organised by New York Road Runners (NYRR) and sanctioned by World Athletics. It is an official Abbott World Marathon Major and receives support from local authorities to manage large-scale traffic control across the NYC metro area on race day. Expected weather during the NEW YORK CITY Marathon What is the expected weather during the New York City Marathon? Early November in New York City typically offers cool, crisp conditions, with average temperatures between 8–15°C (46–59°F). These conditions are ideal for maintaining a steady pace and enjoying the marathon experience without overheating. The NEW YORK CITY Marathon start line Where is the New York City Marathon start line? The start line is located on Staten Island. The race begins with the traditional cannon blast and the iconic song “New York, New York” playing, creating an unforgettable start to the world’s largest marathon. Transportation from Manhattan and other boroughs is coordinated by NYRR to ensure a smooth race morning. the NEW YORK CITY Marathon finish line Where is the New York City Marathon finish line? The finish line is located in Central Park, Manhattan, providing a memorable end to the 26.2-mile race. Timing is recorded using both gun time and net time, ensuring accurate results for all participants. Water and Gatorade are available at nearly every mile to support runners along the course. entry fee for the NEW YORK CITY Marathon 2026 How much is the entry fee for the New York City Marathon 2026? The entry fee varies depending on registration method. When booking with Sports Tours International, your race entry is included when you book our package, so there’s no need to handle fees separately. Independent runners entering through the lottery must pay the standard NYRR entry fee. The history of the NEW YORK CITY Marathon What is the history of the New York City Marathon? First held in 1970, the New York City Marathon has been run every year since, except for 2012 and 2020. Known as one of the most popular marathons in the world, it covers all five boroughs of New York City, with a course that challenges runners while showcasing iconic landmarks. The marathon attracts roughly 50,000 runners, features hydration stations with water and Gatorade nearly every mile, and has produced elite records like Geoffrey Mutai’s 2:05:06 men’s fastest time in 2011.
